profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cisco
profile.summary: I am a motivated Computer Science graduate and software engineer with experience at Cisco Systems and Best Buy. I specialize in developing network solutions, enhancing web applications, and creating user-friendly interfaces. Skilled in JavaScript, React, Python, and UI development, I enjoy solving complex problems and collaborating with teams to deliver impactful results. I am passionate about continuous learning and innovation, I am open to new software engineering opportunities where I can contribute, grow, and make a difference.

honors.title: App Development with Swift Level 1
honors.description: Swift is a robust and intuitive programming language created by Apple to build apps for iOS, Mac, Apple TV, and Apple Watch. App Development with Swift Level 1 certification recognizes knowledge of the Swift programming language, app developer tools, and core components of apps. Individuals who have passed the certification exam demonstrate foundational knowledge of Swift, Xcode, and app development tools covered by the App Development with Swift course from Apple.
honors.issuer: Issued by Apple Inc. via Acclaim · Jan 2021
